summary: Added `conn.commit()` after all `INSERT` and `UPDATE` operations to ensure data persistence. Added extensive type hints to method parameters and return values. Included comprehensive docstrings for the `MemoryStore` class and all its methods. Added `PRAGMA wal_autocheckpoint=1000;` for better WAL mode efficiency.

Completing the truncated type hint `List[float]` is also important.

**3. `src/swarms/improver/memory.py`**
